description: Real import and play-through of FinancialLiteracy_Nexus_Import_v1.1.0.zip in the game server (untangle-the-nexus commit 4b77e64, PostgreSQL 16 test database), using the game's importer, engine, and mastery code. Run by a temporary local test that was not committed to the game repo.
notes: S24 MAIN at 3 of 5 sent the student through every backward section in curriculum order; each served item had requiresExplanation=false; kinds are the target skills' own auto-checkable types.
After the backward chain the student returned to FL-S24-M (MAIN).
4 of 5 repeated MAIN; 5 of 5 recorded mastery and the normal main-skill reward (300 seconds in time_ledger).
Go Deeper F1 unlocked; the five served F1 questions showed an intro exactly when the bank has one (2 of 5, matching S24-F1-Q1 and Q2) and never required an explanation or recording.
